parent_review.original_I138_audit: I141 passes all original I138 paid assertions without repairs at their original constants and scopes. It preserves finite support jets versus dynamical caustics, the simple directed graph convention for L=(n-1)K, all-active affine derivatives, nonnested scale iteration, rolling monomolecular windows, nonlinear ratio bounds and common-forcing synchronization, and the distinct stronger invariance/unbounded-class/all-initial-entry obstructions. This parent review is selective, not a second full original-proof audit.
selected_mathematical_checks: On a compact class each consumed species occurs in the source complex. Thus the explicit C bounds all negative consumption by C x_i, giving a positive exponential lower bound and global Caratheodory continuation. Multiplication over source exponents gives F1 on every starting window; variation of constants for x_i gives F2 with the deliberately conservative extra exp(-CT) factor.

The 2A reversible with A+B schedule has period two and is PE on every length-two sliding window. Its pure forward solution is A(t)=A0/(1+A0 t); in the next reverse phase, A increases by an amount bounded away from zero as epsilon tends to zero. Since that increase is the integrated AB flux, division by A0 B0 diverges. This excludes a bounded upper effective coefficient frozen at the initial state, not permanence.

Under SC, no siphon can lie in the initial low-species set because its conserved positive weighted mass would be less than half its fixed value. If the iterative all-reactants support closure stops before covering all species, its complement is exactly a siphon. At a newly added species the selected reaction has source exponent zero and positive integer product exponent, so F2 supplies gamma delta_r^d. Old species keep the exponential floor. At most n rounds and arbitrary rolling starts give the stated all-initial delay nT.

For A+B reversible with C and C reversible with D the two displayed conservation vectors annihilate every reaction. The minimal siphons are exactly {A,C,D} and {B,C,D}; the stated M,d,C and epsilon are valid. In particular C needs two outgoing C terms, whereas A and B each need at most KM.

In rank one, all complexes in one nontrivial linkage class differ along v. At a segment endpoint, v_i>0 on the zero coordinates, so sigma>0 and the rare-species order difference equals c_e sigma. Distinct complexes cannot tie in order within that class. Weak reversibility supplies an increasing edge from a minimum; every decreasing source has integer order at least p+1, also across linkage classes after taking their minimum p. Self-loops and isolated complexes are excluded as stated.

The factors g_y are strictly positive on the chosen closed boundary band; coordinates outside the endpoint zero set have a positive minimum there. Summing negative terms gives -D z^(p+1), while one PE edge supplies a_* k z^p. Since rho0<=1 and p is a nonnegative integer, this implies z prime >=-D z, including p=0.

If a whole window remains in the band and its endpoint is at most twice its start, integration of z prime >=-D z forward and backward yields exp(-DT) z(s)<=z(u)<=2 exp(DT) z(s). The proposed rho makes the integrated negative term at most half the PE positive term. The complementary doubling case gives increment greater than z(s). Thus R4 is valid with the stated constants without any unconditional upper monomial comparison.

For a trajectory remaining below rho, complete-window endpoints increase by at least eta(z0), which is nondecreasing in z0 even at p=0. R5 is a safe loose exit-time bound. Any subsequent excursion below rho cannot last T: applying R4 from its start at rho would contradict remaining below rho. Gronwall within that shorter excursion gives rho exp(-DT). Repeating at the other endpoint gives R7 and compact-initial uniform entry, not fresh-schedule invariance.

The proposed six-complex ring is conservative of rank two with accessible critical siphons. At the A vertex the source complexes of rare degree one are 2A+B and 2A+C; outgoing reactions either transfer B and C or increase B+C. Negative total-rare-mass terms have order at least two. This excludes a negative linear total-rare-mass drift at that vertex, not repeated excursions or transitions between faces.

The twelve periodic schedules have exactly one unit of each reaction per period and hence satisfy PE on every shifted period. The recorded RK4 values have no certified numerical error or asymptotic significance. They are exploratory evidence only and were not rerun by the parent or verifier.
